description: This file defines the Tracker class for the SuiteCRM module, including properties, constructor, and methods for tracking user activities, retrieving recent views, and managing visibility. It extends the SugarBean class and interacts with session and database components.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: A class representing tracker entries in the CRM, handling recent item retrieval, visibility toggling, and page logging. Extends SugarBean.

methods.name: get_recently_viewed
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently viewed items for a user, optionally filtered by modules, using session and database queries.

methods.name: makeInvisibleForAll
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a specified item to invisible and updates related session breadcrumbs.

methods.name: logPage
methods.description: Logs page view timing, updating session and global state.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Overrides method to disable ACL role support for this bean.
